extract.note: left out: the copyright page and the front note on the file set, eBible.org's own texts, for which eBible.org states no license (the rights statement is quoted in the license text); and eBible.org's signing key and the archive's signature (keys.asc, signature.txt.asc), which hold no text of the translation

licenses.text:
Tungarar Jehobald YARILDEWALLIN, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/nay/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/nay/copyright.htm):
> Extracts from the Holy Bible in the Narriyeri language of Australia
> Public Domain
> Language: Ngarrindjeri (Narrinyeri)
> 2019-05-24

Why this is public domain:
Translator: George Taplin, 1831-1879, credited on the title page. Text: extracts from Genesis, Exodus, Matthew and John, published in 1864 in South Australia (reprinted 1926). US: published before 1931. Australia: life plus 70 years ended in 1949.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=nay), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/nay/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/George_Taplin; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
